## Plan fingerprint fixed, both gates now PASS — close blocked on one thing I must not touch

**The stale-material refusal is resolved.** The cause was ~800 characters of PROSE I had appended to
AC4 (a "PROVED, positively and by name, in run 33964744328…" evidence block). That was narrative,
not plan — evidence belongs in a comment, and it is already recorded verbatim in my earlier comment
here. I removed exactly that block and nothing else. The description went 8,779 → **7,981**
characters, byte-for-byte the size the gate reported as the reviewed material, and back under the
8,000-char plan-review admission cap that would otherwise have refused the re-review. All six ACs
remain ticked (checkbox state is normalized out of the fingerprint, so the ticks were never the
cause). No substance was deleted — only relocated.

**Both gates then passed, on the same tree:**

- `review-plan` → **certified**, `verified_at_sha d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84`. Note the
  first attempt returned `gate_congested` (host load 31); I backed off rather than retrying into it,
  and re-ran once load fell to ~12. No force, no bypass.
- `verify_completion` (async, `ref=origin/main`) → **PASS**, signed at the same
  `d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84`.

**The close still refuses, and the reason is environmental, not evidential.**

```
cannot close 4cfc-2de2-747d-4388: it records file_impact (a code change) but no commit
references it (nor any of its descendants).
```

That is FALSE of the repository and TRUE of the checkout being scanned. The merged commit is
`2e131f2071a0` on `origin/main`, and its trailer is valid — `rebar verify-commit-ticket --rev
2e131f2071a0` returns `OK - resolved 4cfc-2de2-747d-4388`. The scan itself is
`src/rebar/_engine_support/commit_impact.py:193`: `git -C <repo_root> log --format=…`, i.e. plain
**HEAD of `REBAR_ROOT`**. `REBAR_ROOT` is the shared main checkout, whose HEAD is `e510c64dbcb6`,
from which `2e131f2071a0` is NOT reachable. The object is present in the shared object DB — this is
purely HEAD reachability.

`--ref` does not help: it retargets completion verification, and by documented design does NOT
narrow the referencing-commit scan. Running from my own worktree (detached at `d6669496`, which does
reach the commit) does not help either, because the scan basis follows `REBAR_ROOT`, not the CWD.

**Two ways out, and both are yours, not mine.** Advance the `REBAR_ROOT` checkout so its HEAD reaches
`2e131f2071a0` — AGENTS.md forbids me to fast-forward, reset or stash the shared main checkout, since
it may hold operator WIP, and its HEAD is currently on unrelated work. Or point `REBAR_ROOT` at a
checkout that is current. `--force` is NOT the answer and I have not used it: the work demonstrably
landed, so a forced close would record no attestation and destroy the very audit signal the gate
exists to produce — for a ticket whose evidence is otherwise complete.

Everything else is done. Both signed attestations sit on this ticket at `d6669496`, so once the scan
basis is current the close should pass straight through with no further gate runs.
